SL-004 is implemented and committed (`5303340`). `npm test` passes (28 of 28) and `npm run typecheck` is clean. I wrote `tests/invalid-titles.test.ts` first and ran it. The page tests failed as expected before any code was written; I only looked at the tail of that output, so I didn't see the API tests fail individually. - **Backend:** `POST /api/tasks` now returns `400` with `{"error":{"code":"validation_failed","message":…}}` and stores nothing. The code is in `src/tasks.ts` and `src/app.ts`. - **Empty or whitespace-only title:** "A title is required." - **Title over 500 characters after trimming:** "The title is too long (maximum 500 characters)." A title of exactly 500 characters plus surrounding spaces is accepted. - **Missing or non-string title:** "Title must be a string." This isn't in the slice's acceptance criteria. I added it because the validator would otherwise crash on a non-string, and the tasks-api contract lists it. - **Page:** `public/index.html` has a new `

`. `public/app.js` shows the server's message there and keeps what the owner typed. On success it clears both the message and the field. - **Page tests:** `app.js` runs in a `node:vm` sandbox with a fake DOM and a scripted `fetch`, so the message behavior is tested without a browser. A real browser would still be the way to check that the message looks right on screen. - **Not done:** - Invalid JSON is not handled. The slice doesn't mention it, so a malformed body still gets Hono's default error instead of the contract's `invalid_json` 400. - I left the slice file's `status: planned` and the planning docs (`wbs.md`, `active.json`) alone, since you didn't ask me to close the slice.
